summary: Added a synchronous native DOM renderer with keyed reconciliation, controlled bindings, focus and selection preservation, callback fencing, outerHTML-v1 snapshots, and physical unmount. Extracted descriptor-based view validation for shared use by React and DOM. Focused Chromium and React regressions pass; the integrated four-app/five-fixture matrix remains pending N3.

preserved_red.result: exit 1 before implementation because frontend/dom/renderer.mjs did not exist (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND)

changes: The DOM renderer builds real browser nodes without importing React or ReactDOM and performs synchronous keyed reconciliation.
View validation snapshots descriptors and admits the observed GoScript struct and GoSlice ABI without invoking getters or spare-capacity factories.
React and DOM share the same validation and view-record helpers; the React regression suite remains green.
Focus snapshots and restoration use the existing React logical identity record, with selection direction preserved.
DOM snapshots return the mounted root outerHTML and ordered live controls; unmount removes all container children and event listeners.
limits: N2 did not execute the integrated four-app/five-fixture native/direct-JS/DOM oracle; N3 owns that matrix, which remains pending.
Node 22 emits a non-failing UNDICI-EHPA experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning from the Playwright/undici environment.
